idea: Create a local product workflow that preserves evidence and survives interruption.
goal: Demonstrate task, evidence, review, usage, and recovery state without claiming a production release.

tasks.title: Resolve product constraints
tasks.objective: Capture only material unknowns and persist every answer.
acceptanceCriteria: No known answer is requested twice.
tasks.resumeInstructions: Review INTAKE.json before asking another question.

tasks.title: Build the evidence base
tasks.objective: Record decision-relevant sources, confidence, staleness, and licenses.
acceptanceCriteria: Every major claim links to a source record.
tasks.resumeInstructions: Open EVIDENCE.jsonl and continue unresolved questions.

tasks.title: Set architecture and critical path
tasks.objective: Choose the smallest maintainable architecture and an acyclic task graph.
acceptanceCriteria: Every task has a measurable output.
tasks.resumeInstructions: Recompute the critical path after scope changes.

tasks.title: Implement recoverable state
tasks.objective: Write atomic snapshots, append-only journal events, and task orchestration.
tasks.resumeInstructions: Run the recovery suite before further state changes.

tasks.title: Close adversarial findings
tasks.objective: Reproduce, fix, and regression-test evidence-backed review findings.
acceptanceCriteria: Every high finding is fixed or explicitly waived.
tasks.resumeInstructions: Continue from finding F5, then rerun all tests.

tasks.title: Run release gates
tasks.objective: Publish only when the central journey and required quality checks have evidence.
tasks.resumeInstructions: Do not start until review is complete.

findings.evidence: Cross-platform integration is not yet recorded.
findings.impact: An adapter may fail to start on Windows.
findings.fix: Run the adapter fixture on Windows CI.
findings.verification: Windows CI reports start, result, stop, and resume.

evidence.summary: Forced interruption and journal replay tests pass.
Local Claude installation reports the plugin enabled.

decisions: This fixture is demo data and is not a release claim.
